title: Replace Words With Shortest Root
hints: you always want the SHORTEST matching root - if you walk a word's characters from its start, which matching root would you hit first?
insert every dictionary root into a trie, marking end-of-word nodes
for each sentence word, walk the trie one character at a time following the word's letters

the moment you land on a node marked as end-of-word, stop immediately and use the characters collected so far as the replacement - that's guaranteed to be the shortest matching root since you found it first
if you fall off the trie (no child for the next needed character) before hitting any end-of-word node, the original word is left unchanged
commonMistakes: finding A matching root but not verifying it's the shortest one (e.g. checking roots in dictionary order instead of walking shortest-first)
replacing a word even when no root actually matches, due to a moved on empty prefix or off-by-one in the walk
not stopping the trie walk exactly at the first end-of-word node, instead walking to the end of the sentence word

content.problemStatement:
You're given a space-delimited dictionary of word roots and a separate
space-delimited sentence.

**For every word in the sentence, if one or more roots in the dictionary is a prefix of that word, replace the word with the shortest such root, and return the modified sentence as a single space-delimited string.**

If no root is a prefix of a word, leave the word unchanged.
constraints: dictionary and sentence consist only of lowercase English letters and spaces
notes: a sentence word is itself already one of the roots (should be replaced by itself, unchanged in value)
a dictionary root is longer than a sentence word it can't possibly prefix (never matches)
a sentence word matched by no root at all (left unchanged)

sampleTestCases.input: dictionary = "cat bat rat", sentence = "the cattle was rattled by the battery"
sampleTestCases.output: "the cat was rat by the bat"
sampleTestCases.expectedOutput: "the cat was rat by the bat"

sampleTestCases.input: dictionary = "a b c", sentence = "aadsfasf absbs bbab cadsfafs"
sampleTestCases.explanation: every word is replaced by its single-letter root; both aadsfasf and absbs start with a, so both become a
all three roots are prefixes of "aaaaa", so the shortest, "a", wins
